retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban collage style featuring torn paper textures, chain-link backgrounds, and a mix of blackletter and serif typography in a sepia-toned palette.
triggerTerms: urban grunge photography with chain link fence

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition using jagged, white torn-paper borders to frame a group of subjects against an industrial chain-link fence, unified by a warm, desaturated sepia and high-contrast lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Torn paper edges acting as organic frames for geometric industrial backgrounds
High-contrast lighting on subjects against dark, textured shadows
Juxtaposition of aggressive blackletter display type with traditional serif body text
Warm sepia and red accents against a desaturated, gritty environment
coreInvariants: High-contrast, low-key lighting on human subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four male subjects arranged in a triangular formation, occupying the central and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a black leather jacket, positioned slightly lower than the others.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top blackletter title, moves down through the subjects, and settles on the red text block at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures, subjects, and overlapping paper layers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and warm browns in the photography and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white from the torn paper edges.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used for the secondary text banner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, ornate blackletter strokes with sharp terminals.
Body text uses high-contrast serifs with vertical stress.
Secondary display text uses a lowercase, rounded serif style.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' in the red banner has a distinctive curved crossbar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive contrast between historical blackletter and modern, clean serif faces.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate blackletter display style.
Approximates the traditional serif body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty urban scene with four men in leather jackets standing in front of a chain-link fence, processed with a warm sepia filter. Overlay jagged, white torn-paper textures at the top and bottom edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place blackletter display text at the top center. Add a red horizontal banner at the bottom right with white serif text, and a block of serif body text on a white torn-paper scrap above it.

verificationChecks: Ensure torn paper edges have visible fiber texture.
Check that the red banner is slightly rotated to match the collage feel.
Verify the blackletter font has high contrast and sharp points.

adjustableVariables: Density of the chain-link fence pattern
postGenerationChecks: Does the image look like a physical collage?
Is the blackletter text legible against the background?
Is the red accent color the only high-saturation element?
Are the torn edges white and jagged?
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Grunge Collage = (Sepia Photography + Chain Link Texture) * Torn Paper Framing + (Blackletter Header / Red Serif Banner)
